title: 紫色嗰條
mood: sheepish, stubborn and finally laughing at himself
subject: a 34-year-old office worker who spends eight weeks of lunch breaks failing the same purple V3 route at a bouldering wall on the eleventh floor of a Kwun Tong industrial building, until a ten-year-old tops it on her first try and then shows him the heel hook
caption: Cantonese UK garage pop in the late-1990s London 2-step style. Shuffled 2-step drums with swung sixteenth hi-hats, a skippy kick that avoids beat three and a rimshot snare on two and four with ghost notes; a warbling organ bassline that bends between notes; M1-style organ chord stabs on the off-beats; soft Rhodes seventh chords under the verses; a reverse-cymbal swell into each chorus. Clean and close, low end tight and centred, Rhodes and stabs spread wide, the voice dry and forward. Male voice in his thirties, smooth and light with an R&B lean, sitting slightly behind the beat, light harmonies on the chorus, every hook line sung straight. 132 BPM, F minor. Sheepish and stubborn, an office worker losing to the same purple bouldering route every lunch break and finally laughing at himself. No four-on-the-floor house kick, no drum and bass breakbeat, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no big EDM drop.
lyrics:
[Verse]
一點正 衝出公司 飯都唔食
直上觀塘 工廈十一樓
紫色V3 第五粒 圓到好似個菠蘿包
我一捉就甩 成個人跌落張墊

[Pre-Chorus]
兩點之前 要返去打卡
雙手震到 打email打錯晒字

[Chorus]
紫色嗰條 紫色嗰條
八個禮拜 我都跌喺同一粒
十隻手指 揸到甩晒皮
你等我 聽日一點再上嚟

[Verse]
第六個禮拜 我買咗對新鞋
細過我對腳兩個碼 痛到行唔到路
上網睇片 慢鏡睇咗十幾次
去到第五粒 照樣跌落張墊

[Verse]
暑假嚟咗個細路女 睇落最多十歲
佢阿媽坐喺凳度 低頭睇電話
佢望咗兩眼 搽少少粉 就上
三十秒 雙手捉住頂嗰粒

[Pre-Chorus]
佢跳落嚟 拍走手上啲粉
叫我一聲叔叔 我先三十四咋

[Chorus]
紫色嗰條 紫色嗰條
八個禮拜 我都跌喺同一粒
十隻手指 揸到甩晒皮
個細路女 第一次就上咗

[Bridge]
佢話 叔叔 你淨係識用手
隻腳踭勾住佢 個人就貼埋牆
我照住做 一拉 就企咗上去
八個禮拜 我都唔記得自己有腳

[Pre-Chorus]
我企喺頂 望返落張墊
佢阿媽終於擡起頭 拍咗兩下手

[Chorus]
紫色嗰條 紫色嗰條
八個禮拜 我都跌喺同一粒
十隻手指 揸到甩晒皮
原來要用腳 唔係死揸

[Outro]
兩點正 返到公司 褲腳仲有粉
佢話 叔叔 下個禮拜試藍色
